scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend')) { execSync('npm --prefix frontend run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { execSync('npx next build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.start: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend')) { execSync('npm --prefix frontend start', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { execSync('npx next start', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.dev: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend')) { execSync('npm --prefix frontend run dev', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { execSync('npx next dev', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
